changelog:
- Initial release of "citation-formatting" skill.
- Supports formatting literature entries (books, journal articles, theses, web resources, conference papers, newspapers) into standardized reference lists and in-text citations.
- Offers two widely used formats: GB/T 7714—2015 (Chinese) and APA 7th Edition (English).
- Handles incomplete information (e.g., missing author, date, pages) according to citation standards, marking missing items rather than fabricating details.
- Provides citation templates, detailed formatting rules, guidance for various document types, and output suggestions to ensure clarity and consistency.
summary: 将文献信息（书籍、期刊论文、学位论文、网页、会议论文、报纸文章等）按指定规范整理、格式化，并生成参考文献条目或文中引用。支持 GB/T 7714—2015（中文论文常用）与 APA 第 7 版（英文论文常用）两种格式。当用户给出零散的文献信息（作者、题名、年份、出版社、刊名、卷期、页码、DOI/URL 等），要求"排版参考文献 / 写参考文献 / 转成 GB/T 或 APA 格式 / 做引用"时使用。涉及具体条目格式或标点细节时，按需读取 references/ 下的资料。
